purpose: Prepare external angle observations of a restrained unpowered mechanism; not an instruction to operate hardware.

coordinate_conventions.q2: shoulder relative to Art1, unwrapped radians
coordinate_conventions.q3: elbow relative to Art2, unwrapped radians
coordinate_conventions.phi: elbow gearbox output relative to Art1, unwrapped radians; not source D or Z
coordinate_conventions.approach_direction: explicit observed direction label +1/-1, definition to be recorded
coordinate_conventions.unknown_output_scale: If phi is only an unknown motor/channel scale, physical carrier and belt ratio cannot be separated from that scale.

observation_plan.reminder: Repeated identical poses do not establish independent excitation; no travel is authorized by this worksheet.

uncertainty_gate: Synthetic OLS output-noise intervals do not cover uncertain measured predictors, quantization, hysteresis or correlated observations. Physical records need a separately reviewed estimator and acceptance process.
